title: Version 1.42.0
body:
Version 1.42.0

October 15th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed infused cores not working
  • Fixed fusion coil not working when created
  • Fixed signs not displaying text

Version 1.42.1

October 20th, 2023

Changed:

  • Changed Hallow plank texture due to identically with Bone

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed credits not loading the contributors page

Version 1.42.2

October 21st, 2023

Changes:

  • Reverted Hallow smooth plank texture change
  • Hallow wood planker form material is now white granite

Version 1.42.3

October 24th, 2023

Added:

  • Experimenting with VR, added visible hands when in VR

Changed:

  • The world is no longer very large when in VR

Version 1.42.4

October 24th, 2024

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed planker repeatedly eating up those planks!
